heroHeadline: DRC and M23 Agree Peace Roadmap as Fighting Widens in Fizi, Minembwe and Walungu
heroSubtitle: A Geneva-brokered roadmap sets sequenced steps for Doha peace talks and the first EJVM+ ceasefire verification mission in Minembwe, even as drone strikes and clashes spread across South Kivu's Fizi and Minembwe highlands and into Walungu territory for the first time since May, alongside continued fighting in Kalehe and Masisi.
